checks: Evaluate a conjunction: scans may pass and one correction close, but archiving still depends on closure of every action for this batch. Independent blind solve and item-level English, Traditional Chinese, answer and each distractor verified after language corrections.

vocabulary.note: off-site 表示不在目前廠區，不代表已銷毀或不再保留紀錄。

activeQuestion.prompt: The factory moves paper inspection records to the off-site archive only after the scans have been verified and all corrective actions for that batch are closed. Batch 18’s scans have been verified. The inspector closed a labeling issue yesterday, but a separate measurement issue for Batch 18 is still open. The factory should ____.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 工廠只有在掃描檔已驗證，且該批次所有矯正措施都已結案時，才會把紙本檢驗紀錄移到外部檔案庫。第 18 批的掃描檔已驗證。檢驗員昨天結案了一項標籤問題，但第 18 批另一項量測問題仍未結案。工廠應該____。

options.text: move the paper records to the archive now that one issue is closed
options.zh: 其中一項問題已結案，現在就把紙本移到外部檔案庫
options.whyZh: 仍有量測問題未結案；規定要求該批全部矯正措施結案。

options.text: scan the paper records again to resolve the measurement issue
options.zh: 重新掃描紙本，以結束量測問題
options.whyZh: 掃描檔已驗證；重新掃描不能視為結清量測問題。

options.text: keep the paper records on site until the measurement issue is closed
options.zh: 在量測問題結案前，繼續將紙本留在廠內
options.whyZh: 掃描檔已驗證，但量測問題仍未結案；兩項要求都滿足才能移到外部檔案庫。

options.text: send the records to the archive because the scans passed verification
options.zh: 因掃描檔已通過驗證，把紙本送到外部檔案庫
options.whyZh: 驗證只是移檔的其中一項條件；目前仍有矯正措施未結案。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 掃描檔已驗證，但量測問題仍未結案；兩項要求都滿足才能移到外部檔案庫。
activeQuestion.evidence: The factory moves paper inspection records to the off-site archive only after the scans have been verified and all corrective actions for that batch are closed. Batch 18’s scans have been verified. The inspector closed a labeling issue yesterday, but a separate measurement issue for Batch 18 is still open. The factory should ____.

originalQuestion.prompt: All inspection records must be stored in accordance ____ the document-retention policy.
originalQuestion.promptZh: 所有檢驗紀錄都必須____文件保存政策儲存。

options.whyZh: in accordance of 不是標準搭配。
in accordance with 是「依照」的固定片語。
in accordance 不與 by 形成此用語。
in accordance at 不是表示依照政策的搭配。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: in accordance with 是「依照」的固定片語。
originalQuestion.evidence: in accordance with the document-retention policy

vocabulary.note: 依規定期限與方式保留文件。
